title: rhus chinensis var. roxburghii
intro: Rhus chinensis var. roxburghii, commonly known as Chinese sumac or Poison Sumac, is a variety of the Rhus chinensis plant, which belongs to the Anacardiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Chinese sumac include analgesic, anti-pyretic, and anti-arthritic effects, attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and relieve pain. The bioactive constituents of Rhus chinensis var. roxburghii include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
